title: UAP SPP 201 Pre-Design and Service Boundaries

claims.claim_text: SPP 201 covers Pre-design Services including consultation, pre-feasibility studies, architectural programming, and space planning.
claims.article_location: The rule that decides the answer
claims.conflict_class: two-source-pack; no conflict detected by script

claims.claim_text: Consultation involves oral/written advice, direction, conferences, evaluations, and appraisals whether or not the client pursues the project.
claims.conflict_class: two-source-pack; no conflict detected by script

claims.claim_text: Document 401-402 does not cover Fulltime Construction Supervision, Project/Construction Management, Pre-Design Services, allied services, Design-Build, or construction agreement work.
claims.locator: UAP Document 401-402 / Article 5-6 excerpt / PDF p.1
claims.conflict_class: two-source-pack; no conflict detected by script

claims.claim_text: Under UAP Document 401-402 Article 7.08 on suspended or abandoned work, completion of the Contract Documents Phase is treated as 85% of the architect’s work in that agreement; the remaining 15% is stated as 10% for Article 1723 liability and 5% for construction-phase service.
claims.conflict_class: two-source-pack; no conflict detected by script
claims.sme_notes: Scoped to Document 401-402 Article 7.08 so it is not misread as a universal UAP fee-allocation rule. Raw source states the 85/15 split verbatim.
